name: cave-of-shadows
title: The Cave of Shadows
description: Plato's cave for The Cave: a dark stone floor inside a ring of grey rock, the smooth pale wall of shadows at the north, the captives' bench before it, the raised parapet with three carried shapes on poles, the fire in its ring of stones behind, stalagmites, and a flight of stairs up the east wall to a gap in the rock with a tan ledge outside under the sun on its column.
